name: faith
quote: My hearts says she's going to be ok.
description: Confidence in the accuracy of a belief about something or someone not based on rational proof or experience.

variations.name: faith in a person
variations.description: Believing without evidence that a particular person can accomplish a certain goal.
examples: My kid is going be great at soccer someday.

variations.name: existential faith
variations.description: Believing without evidence in the accuracy of a framework of statements and predictions about reality.
examples: Cheaters always get what they deserve.
My religion will guide me to a better afterlife.

comparisons.description: If someone is certain in their faith, the source of that sense of certainty is not justifiable from experience or logic -- it's a type of trust in an external force. On the other hand, when you're _mentally_ certain about something, the source is not based on an external trust, but it's from past experience or logic.

commentaries.quote: Faith is believing that the outcome will be what it should be, no matter what it is.
Faith is not something to grasp, it is a state to grow into.

conditions: Confidence in the accuracy of a belief about something or someone.
The source of the confidence is based on trust in an external factor rather than on rational proof or experience.
